displayIdentity.body: Household vessels and gentle correction answer quarrels. Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor. and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
